name: Exterior Metal Finish Coat 1
intent: DTM acrylic finish by method + item type. Brush, spray, or spray_backbrush. LF for railing/gutter, EA for ornamental.
doctrine: Metal finish coat 1. DTM acrylic. Brush 20 LF/hr, spray 32 LF/hr, ornamental 3 EA/hr (~20 min/piece). Profile complexity modifier applies. No intercoat sanding on exterior metal (not doors/windows). Spray_backbrush: spray deposits, brush works into recesses.
